response.sql:
WITH bucket_counts AS (
  SELECT
    o.timespan,
    COUNT(*) AS bucket_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS rm
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON o.recordvault = rm.ordervault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
),
shares AS (
  SELECT
    timespan,
    bucket_count,
    1.0 * bucket_count / SUM(bucket_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM bucket_counts
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT share, bucket_count
  FROM shares
  WHERE share > AVG(share) OVER ()
)
SELECT
  SUM(bucket_count) AS total_count,
  AVG(share) AS average_share,
  AVG(share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average;

assumptions.assumption: Each risk/margin record contributes one count, including multiple records matched to the same order. NULL timespan values form one bucket, and shares and the average share are calculated across the observed buckets.
